name: NotificationPopover
description:
A NotificationList in a fixed-size popover for the shell. It holds the list's box through
loading, empty and full, and every row shows each time it opens. Give AccountButton or
Rail.Item the host's unread count: this component changes neither.
signature: ({ trigger, open, defaultOpen, onOpenChange, side, align, anchor, finalFocus, "aria-label": label, ...list }: NotificationPopoverProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the overlay relative to its anchor.

props.name: anchor
props.type: Element | import("@floating-ui/dom").VirtualElement | import("react").RefObject<Element | null> | (() => Element | import("@floating-ui/dom").VirtualElement | null) | null | undefined
props.description: Anchor used to position floating content.

props.name: defaultFilter
props.description: The chosen filter at first when uncontrolled. Default the first.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether it starts open when uncontrolled.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: The empty line. Default "No notifications".

props.name: error
props.description: Why the list failed, shown in its box. Default a factual line. Pass `true` for that line.

props.name: filter
props.description: The chosen filter's id, controlled.

props.name: filtering
props.description: `client` filters the loaded rows; `host` shows `items` as given, for a list paged on the server (R16.7). Default `client`.

props.name: filters
props.description: Choices in the filter, or `false` for no filter. Default All and Unread.

props.name: finalFocus
props.type: boolean | import("react").RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((closeType: import("@base-ui/utils/useEnhancedClickHandler").InteractionType) => void | boolean | HTMLElement | null) | undefined
props.description: Where focus returns on close. Default the trigger; pass the opener when there is none.

props.name: groupBy
props.description: How rows are grouped. Default `day`.

props.name: hasMore
props.description: More rows exist. The list calls `onLoadMore` when its end comes into view, and shows a button there.

props.name: holdNew
props.description: New rows wait behind a count until asked for, so nothing moves under the pointer (R17.3). `false` shows them at once. Default true.

props.name: items
props.description: The rows. The host keeps them: the list leaves the page while the popover is closed.

props.name: loading
props.description: First load, or a whole list being replaced: skeleton rows in the list's box, and nothing is held.

props.name: loadingMore
props.description: The next page is on its way.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Skeleton rows to draw. Default 5.

props.name: loadMoreError
props.description: The next page failed. Its place shows this and Retry, which calls `onLoadMore`. Default a factual line. Pass `true` for that line.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called for an item's own `action`.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when a row is dismissed. Without it there is no dismiss control.

props.name: onFilterChange
props.description: Called with the chosen filter's id.

props.name: onLoadMore
props.description: Called for the next page.

props.name: onMarkAllRead
props.description: Called for Mark all read, which may reach rows not loaded. Without it there is no such control.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called when a row is opened. Makes rows without `href` a button; with `href`, call `preventDefault` to route.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next open state.

props.name: onReadChange
props.type: ((ids: readonly string[], read: boolean) => void) | undefined
props.description: Called when rows are marked read or unread, opening one included. Without it there is no read control.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Offers Retry after `error`, and calls it.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether it is open, controlled.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side of the anchor; collision handling may choose another side.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens it. Omit it and pass `anchor` when something else opens it, such as a menu item or a rail item.

props.name: unreadCount
props.description: Unread rows everywhere, loaded or not. Mark all read stays available while this is above zero. Default: counted from the rows.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
